name: smwmusic-animal-crossing
title: Animal Crossing - 7 A.M.
description:
A redone version of my first port with better instruments and more optimization. It's the happy 7 AM theme from the original Animal Crossing. Perfect for happy, grassland, town levels, or overworlds.

A huge thank you to bebn legg for helping me make this song sound much better than my older version of this port!
